About Us 
At Topicus, we believe IT should serve society. From healthcare and education to finance, our solutions empower millions of people every day by turning complex challenges into user-friendly platforms. We don't just build software; we increase self-reliance and reduce vulnerability for citizens worldwide.
 
With a team of over 1,800+ "Topicans" across Southeast Asia (Vietnam & Thailand) and Europe (the Netherlands, Romania, Portugal, and Iceland), we are constantly expanding our horizons. Our ambition reaches far beyond Europe, driven by a shared mission to make a meaningful difference.
 
About the Role 
We are looking for a motivated Intern .NET Developer to join the Akkuro Lending development team (). You will help build a cutting-edge fintech platform in a truly global setting, applying your academic foundation to high-impact, real-world projects. This role offers a fantastic opportunity to contribute to the evolution of our platform while growing your technical expertise side-by-side with seasoned experts from both Vietnam and the Netherlands.
 
Key Responsibilities 
Software Development: Participate in the design, coding, and maintenance of .NET applications. You will work on real-world tasks under the dedicated mentorship of Senior Developers
Global Team Collaboration: Gain hands-on experience in an international environment, collaborate with global team members to deliver high-quality software solutions
Learning through Code Reviews: Participate in code review sessions to industry-standard coding styles and observe gradually apply best practices to your own work
Basic Troubleshooting: Support the team in debugging and resolving technical issues, helping to ensure the smooth execution of project phases
Technical Documentation: Assist in creating and updating clear, comprehensive technical documentation to maintain system transparency.
